inlines.v: TRANSPA'RENT, adjective [Latin trans and pareo, to appear.] 1. Having the property of transmitting rays of light so that bodies can be distinctly seen through; pervious to light; diaphanous; pellucid; as transparent glass; a transparent diamond; opposed to opake. 2. Admitting the passage of light; open porous; as a transparent vail.
